_help: The death popup and the ghost (game pixels in 1366x768). popW/popH = the system popup box, centered on the screen. textY = the first text line from the box top, textStep = the line distance, textPad = the width kept free at both sides. okY = the OK button top from the box top (it is centered across the box). ghostLiftY = how high the ghost sprite origin floats above the ground. ghostBob = how far the ghost drifts up and down, in pixels. DEBUG builds reload this file live on save.
